instruction.name: rotri.h
instruction.description: x86-style rotate right by immediate on 16-bit values.

latencies.notes: rj -> rd chain. Raw slope-method measurement was 2.03; the value is 2 cycle(s) and any earlier range was a rounding artifact.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: rotri.h $r12, $r4, 1; rotri.h $r13, $r5, 1; rotri.h $r14, $r6, 1; rotri.h $r15, $r7, 1; rotri.h $r16, $r8, 1; rotri.h $r17, $r9, 1; rotri.h $r18, $r10, 1; rotri.h $r19, $r11, 1
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'rotri.h $r12, $r4, 1; rotri.h $r13, $r5, 1; rotri.h $r14, $r6, 1; rotri.h $r15, $r7, 1; rotri.h $r16, $r8, 1; rotri.h $r17, $r9, 1; rotri.h $r18, $r10, 1; rotri.h $r19, $r11, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 8.00 cycles, i.e. 1 CPI. Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000); larger unroll factors inflated the value through L1I pressure.

notes: LBT instruction. Only the register source feeds the result.
